teaser: The hardware store aisle where the fluorescent light keeps stuttering, the kind that never quite gets fixed because everyone means to and nobody circles back. You are a life path 8, an ENTP, and that unfinished fix is close to the shape of this crossing: the drive to run the whole operation sits next to a mind that would rather argue about whether the operation needs running at all. The 8 wants the ledger closed and the territory held. The ENTP wants one more angle on the ledger before anyone commits to the numbers. Put those in one person and you get someone who can build an empire and still be rewriting the business plan at the ribbon-cutting.
excerpt: Loyalty gets proven through action more than through words.
